content:
anya: FYI from the nightly stress replay — we saw steady KV memory growth on the 100k-token long-context run after the kernel-selection change earlier today. not a single big spike, just drift. :thinking_face:
marcus: do we have eviction counters or residency histograms for that run? could be fragmentation rather than true leaks.
shiv: I pulled the raw scrape. evictions spiked a bit right after the kernel bump, but overall residency % stayed high. might be page-level fragmentation + partial writes.
sam: can you paste the prom queries you used? happy to eyeball.
shiv: main ones i used:
```promql
sum by (model) (increase(kvcache_evictions_total[5m]))
avg by (model) (kvcache_residency_ratio)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(kvcache_page_utilization_bucket[10m])) by (le, model))
```
marcus: nice. also: `sum(kvcache_frag_pages_total) by (model)` — fragmented page count jumped for model-x.
leo: @anya can you link the replay job ID? I want the perf profile.
anya: replay job is replay/2026-03-15/longctx-100k#42 — logs are at: https://ci.redwood/replays/longctx-100k/42 (private)
observability-bot: dashboard snapshot: https://dash.redwood/kvcache/frag/2026-03-15-42 — note the heatmap on "page utilization" and the step-up in 0.0-0.2 bucket. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
sam: I ran `perf-map` on the replica that saw the worst growth. top stack was the new kernel path in slab allocator -> copy_small_fragments(). looks suspicious.
marcus: that matches fragmentation hypothesis. if the kernel chooses a path that leaves lots of half-full pages, residency stays high but usable slot count decreases -> more evictions even at same memory.
anya: what metrics should we add to detect this automatically? i want an alert before app OOM.
shiv: add a "fragmentation ratio" gauge: fragmented_bytes / total_bytes. also expose `kvcache_free_runs_ratio` (runs of contiguous free slots) and percentile of `page_utilization` per-model.
leo: for alerting: trigger if model-level residency > 85% and fragmentation_ratio > 0.25 for 10m AND evictions/sec increasing > 2x baseline.
marcus: agree. also add a counter labelled by eviction_reason: `kvcache_evictions_total{reason="frag_compaction"}` so the runtime can surface why it evicted.
anya: implementation plan: shiv to add the gauges + reason labels; sam to instrument the allocator to emit fragmented_bytes; leo to add dashboard tiles + alert; i’ll schedule a canary rollback if we confirm regression.
shiv: will open a PR for metrics + a tiny exporter patch tonight.
sam: pushing a small repro that toggles the kernel path and runs the long replay; will attach perf flame and a heapmap.
anya: thanks team. next check-in in 2 hours — if we see the same pattern on canary, we rollback the kernel selection. :thumbsup:
leo: copied. tagging eng-oncall in case it becomes noisy. @eng-oncall :eyes:
marcus: also, let's add a lightweight sampler that logs per-request KV hits for the first 20 requests of a long session — might help correlate reuse loss with fragmentation.
anya: good call. keep notes in the replay issue.
